description: Sen2GF3Floods: A Benchmark Multi-Source Flood Dataset with Dual-Temporal and Active Learning Annotation is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Wenting Chen et al. Flood disasters have global impacts on socioeconomic systems and ecosystems, creating an urgent need for high-quality datasets to support flood detection. However, existing datasets remain constrained by limited source diversity, annotation precision, and scale. Sen2GF3Floods is introduced as the first dataset that integrates pre-disaster Sentinel-2 optical imagery with post-disaster Gaofen-3 SAR imagery. Coverage: global; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Science Data Bank and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4931104688 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
